name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna
description: This is a plan for students of government, government funded and non-affiliated colleges / polytechnics entering the vocational courses set by the government, whose students are certified by the competent authority, as a marginal farmers or whose parents are registered laborers.
department: Maharashtra Council Of Agriculture Education And Research (MCAER)
implementingAuthority: Maharashtra Council Of Agriculture Education And Research (MCAER)

criteria.label: Eligibility Criteria: (As per the GR Dated 07th Oct 2017, 22nd Feb 2018 , 01st March 2018, 18th June 2018 , 11th July 2019)

evidence.quote: Eligibility Criteria: (As per the GR Dated 07th Oct 2017, 22nd Feb 2018 , 01st March 2018, 18th June 2018 , 11th July 2019)

criteria.label: a) Applicant should have Nationality of India.

evidence.quote: a) Applicant should have Nationality of India.
b) Candidate should be Domicile of Maharashtra State.

criteria.label: c) Applicant should be ”Bonafide Student of Institute” and admitted for Professional and Technical course (Diploma / Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR

evidence.quote: c) Applicant should be ”Bonafide Student of Institute” and admitted for Professional and Technical course (Diploma / Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR

criteria.label: d) Deemed University and Private university is not applicable

evidence.quote: d) Deemed University and Private university is not applicable

criteria.label: e) Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

evidence.quote: e) Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

criteria.label: f) Applicant should not avail any other scholarship/stipend.

evidence.quote: f) Applicant should not avail any other scholarship/stipend.

criteria.label: g) For current Academic Year, Only 2 child from family are allowed for benefit of scheme.

evidence.quote: g) For current Academic Year, Only 2 child from family are allowed for benefit of scheme.
h) The Total Annual Income of Family / Guardian should not be more than 8 Lakhs.

criteria.label: i) Minimum 50 % attendance in previous semester (Exception for fresh admitted in College).

evidence.quote: i) Minimum 50 % attendance in previous semester (Exception for fresh admitted in College).

criteria.label: j) During course duration, candidate should not have a gap of 2 or more than 2 years.

evidence.quote: j) During course duration, candidate should not have a gap of 2 or more than 2 years.

criteria.label: k) Candidates are eligible those who have taken an admission under General category and SEBC Category

evidence.quote: k) Candidates are eligible those who have taken an admission under General category and SEBC Category
